Glow-in-the-Dark Buzz Lightyear is the sole digitally-exclusive playable character. Sam Flynn and Quorra were previously exclusive to digital platforms in 2.0, but were produced as physical figures for 3.0. This also makes Glow-in-the-Dark Buzz the only 1.0 character to not be released physically. (Disney Infinity 3.0)
